{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Step 1: Clean revenue — remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Step 2: Identify and exclude internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {len(internal_orders)}")

# Step 3: Filter for completed orders only
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Step 4: Exclude internal test orders from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_orders[~completed_orders.index.isin(internal_orders.index)]['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print result
total_revenue"}
